newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine 3-,6-,9-mo T-bills yields rise, 12-mo fall.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine 3-,6-,9-mo T-bills yields rise, 12-mo fall.

text.p: The average yields at auctions of three-, six- and nine-month treasury bills on February 4 rose from the previous sale on January 30 while yields on 12-month paper dipped, a central bank statement said on Wednesday.

Three-month bills rose to 32.47 percent from 29.87 percent, six-month bills rose to 38.40 percent from 34.51 percent and nine-month bills eased up to 40.96 from 40.62 percent while 12-month bills fell to 43.78 percent from 44.61 percent.
The results of Tuesday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 15 million hryvnia 15 million hryvnia
Amount sold 7.46 million UAH 9.39 million UAH
Actual amount raised 6.91 million UAH 8.74 million UAH
The central bank sold 74,658 T-bills, the bank's statement said. The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
The results of Thursday's six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 17 million hryvnia 17 million hryvnia
Amount sold 7.24 million UAH 11.55 million UAH
Actual amount raised 6.07 million UAH 4.25 million UAH
The central bank sold 72,389 T-bills, the bank's statement said. The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
The results of Thursday's auction of nine-month discount T-bills were as follows:
Issue volume 19 million hryvnia 20 million hryvnia
Amount sold 16.54 million UAH 12.99 million UAH
Actual amount raised 12.66 million UAH 9.96 million UAH
The central bank sold 165,835 T-bills, the bank's statement said. The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
The results of Thursday's 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 20 million hryvnia 22 million hryvnia
Amount sold 20 million UAH 21.61 million UAH
Actual amount raised 13.92 million UAH 14.95 million UAH
The central bank sold 200,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said. The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
